ShortDescription.Value: Growable buildings look the way their circumstances are: cared for, worn or neglected, each one on its own.

Publish.LongDescription:
# Seen Better Days
*"It was better when it was getting worse"* (cit. Caparezza)
Seen Better Days makes growable buildings reflect how they are doing. A building's look follows its real circumstances - its condition, the services it gets, whether it is abandoned, its level and how its street compares with the rest of your city. Nothing ages on a timer: a building whose situation improves cleans up again on its own.
## What you get
- **Colour, city-wide.** Each building gets its own gentle darkening and fading, so two identical towers side by side no longer look like copies. Readable at any distance and light on performance. - **Detail, up close.** Near the camera, weathered buildings pick up stains, cracks, moss, rust, graffiti, rubbish and fallen leaves, scattered at random across the walls. They can take a few seconds to appear.
## Five states, and the decals each one adds
Each state keeps what the one before it had and adds its own marks. Decals come only from the packs listed, and only from the ones you already have: **none of them is required**. With none installed you still get the colour; every pack you add brings its own kind of mark.
- **Maintained** - clean. A well-off building stays here, however old it is. - **Aged** - cracks and leaks, and rust on industrial buildings: - [Cracks and Damage Decal Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/80583/Windows) - [Stains and Leakage Decal Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/80584/Windows) - [[G87] Moss and Rust](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/108303/Windows) (industry only) - **Worn** - dirt, rubbish, fallen leaves, moss, rust and the first tags: - [[G87] Trash Decals](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/87720/Windows) - [Fallen leaves decals](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/96995/Windows) - [[G87] Moss and Rust](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/108303/Windows) - [Scribbles and Tags Decal Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/93949/Windows) - [Urban Decay Pack 1](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/120305/Windows) and [Urban Decay Pack 2](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/120500/Windows) (moss) - **Neglected** - street art, peeling plaster, holes, pipe leaks and torn posters: - [Street Art Decal Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/93866/Windows) - [Urban Decay Pack 1](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/120305/Windows) and [Urban Decay Pack 2](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/120500/Windows) (wall pieces) - **Decayed** - heavy stains and patched walls: - [[G87] Stains and Puddles Decals: Wet Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/87948/Windows) - [[G87] Road Repair: Patch Pack](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/92004/Windows)
**Know a decal pack that would suit?** Tell me in the comments and I will look at adding it to the list.
## Hand-made designs - 0 so far
Random placement is only the start. A building can also get designs made by hand. When a building has a design for its state, the mod uses it; when it has none, it keeps placing decals at random.
The base game, its DLC and the official region packs together have about **3,450 different building models**, and each has four states that carry decals: nearly 14,000 possible designs. This is a long-term project: I will add them a few at a time, starting with the buildings that inspire me most and the ones the mod handles worst.
Hand-made designs are also lighter: placing one took about an eighth of the time of a random placement in testing, because the mod no longer has to study the walls.
**Make your own.** Turn on **Design tools** in the advanced options, select a building and press **Ctrl+Alt+M**: it becomes a blank canvas. Decorate it with Anarchy and Extra Detailing Tools, or start from a design that already exists for it, then export it for the state you choose. It is used in your city straight away, and a zip ready to send is put in `ModsData/SeenBetterDays/To send`. Decals scaled with Extra Detailing Tools are not supported yet.
**Send them to me.** Attach the zip to a post in the [forum thread](https://forum.paradoxplaza.com/forum/threads/seen-better-days-mod.1942860/). I will add them to the mod, and with the next update every player gets them, with your name on them: hovering over a building shows who designed its decals.
## Options
- **Weather buildings** - the whole effect, on or off, live. - **Close-range detail** - the decals, on or off. - **Intensity** - from 25% to 200%. - **Rebuild Seen Better Days appearance** - clears everything the mod drew and applies it again.
With the game's **Show Advanced** switch on: a tooltip explaining why a building looks the way it does, keys to set a building's state by hand, the design tools and the developer shortcuts. All are off by default.
## Good to know
This is an early version. Colours you set yourself, in the game or with Recolor, are kept: the mod weathers them instead of replacing them. If something looks wrong, a comment with a screenshot helps a lot.
Free and open source under the MIT licence: [source on GitHub](https://github.com/merrinaf-tech/Seen-Better-Days).
